text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Due to race arrangements, I ended up 
taking a flight to a distant venue with 
Twin Turbo. While waiting at the airport 
on the day of—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: We're heeeeeeere!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—For some reason, Twin Turbo showed up in 
her racing silks.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: All right! Time to catch our flight!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
H-Here goes! Airplane, airplane... 
A-Airplane~~~~!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It looks like she's forcing herself to act 
hyped up... or rather, she's acting a bit 
suspicious. Could it be—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm not! I'm not nervous at all!! 
Airplanes aren't scary in the slightest!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Because today, we've got Triple Turbo on 
our side!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Heheh! That's this bunny's name!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo puffed out her chest. 
Apparently, 'Triple Turbo' is the name of 
the rabbit attached to her racing attire.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Triple Turbo is my third engine, and it 
always gives Turbo tons of energy!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Just like the stuffed bunny Mama gave me 
back then!

text_block_list.name: Young Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaah!! I don't wanna get a shot!! No, 
no, noooooo...!!!!

text_block_list.name: Turbo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I thought you'd say that. But it's 
alright. A friend is coming over today, 
after all!

text_block_list.name: Young Turbo
text_block_list.text: ...A friend?

text_block_list.name: Turbo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Yes, here you go! It looks just like 
Turbo, a super cute bunny, right?!

text_block_list.name: Young Turbo
text_block_list.text:
!! It's true! Its ears are shaped just 
like Turbo's hair!!

text_block_list.name: Young Turbo
text_block_list.text:
All right, you, keep up with Turbo!! Here 
we goooooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I was so happy back then! All the scary 
feelings just blew completely away!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Triple Turbo is the exact same! No matter 
how scary things get, having him around 
gives me strength—!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: That's why――Turbo can keep on running!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Twin Turbo designed her racing 
outfit in her own way to help make up for 
her timid weaknesses.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She probably wore this today to help 
overcome her fear of boarding airplanes.
choice_data_list:
You really put a lot of thought into 
making this.

You really put a lot of thought into 
making this, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, that's right♪ Pretty praiseworthy, 
huh~~?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: So... that's why—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
A-Airplanes aren't scary at all! I-I'm 
completely, totally fine!
choice_data_list: So it's a dependable racing outfit, huh
It's a dependable racing outfit, isn't it

Will you be fine on your own next time, 
then?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
A-Airplanes aren't scary at all! I-I'm 
completely, totally fine!
choice_data_list: So it's a dependable racing outfit, huh
It's a dependable racing outfit, isn't it

Will you be fine on your own next time, 
then?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Yup, they're just as reliable as Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
With both Triple Turbo and Trainer here 
today, there's nothing to fear♪

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: All right! Airplane, here we goooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having shaken off her initial nervousness, 
she was able to happily enjoy the plane 
flight.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Huh...!? No!! No way!! You have to be 
there with us too, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
T-Triple Turbo is our ultimate weapon! So 
we gotta save it until the very end!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
You're my Trainer, so you have to stay 
right by my side, got it...?!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Do you really get it!? You absolutely, 
positively cannot leave me behind~~...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even with the dependable Triple Turbo 
around, Twin Turbo's needy, spoiled nature 
didn't seem to have changed one bit.
